title: Story Coffee Bellevue
venue_description:
Story Coffee Bellevue - Community Music Venue

Story Coffee Bellevue located at 11011 NE 9th Street in downtown Bellevue is a community-focused coffee shop that serves as a regular open mic venue. The venue has become known for hosting XAMA-organized open mic and jam sessions that welcome musicians of all skill levels and backgrounds.

Coffee Shop Setting

Story Coffee Bellevue provides a casual welcoming coffee shop environment that is ideal for open mic and jam sessions. Unlike bar venues the coffee shop setting is all-ages family-friendly and encourages community participation. Attendees can enjoy quality coffee and light food while experiencing live music.

XAMA Open Mic Programming

Every 2nd and 4th Saturday from 7-9pm XAMA hosts open mic at Story Coffee Bellevue. XAMA is a Seattle-area organization dedicated to fostering community through music. The open mic welcomes all instruments all genres and all skill levels from beginners to experienced musicians. The format emphasizes community building and creative expression over performance quality or judgment.

Bring Your Instrument

Performers are encouraged to bring their own instruments and amps. The coffee shop provides space and an audience but does not provide instruments or backline equipment. This format allows musicians to use their own equipment while participating in a community music gathering.

Community Philosophy

Story Coffee Bellevue and XAMA operate on the philosophy that music brings people together and should be accessible to everyone. The venue creates a judgment-free space where musicians of all abilities can perform and jam together. Regular attendees describe it as an inclusive welcoming community focused on making music rather than critiquing it.

Location & Accessibility

Located in downtown Bellevue the coffee shop is easily accessible by car and public transit. Parking is available nearby with validation at Alley 111 parking garage. The accessible location and convenient timing (evening weekend slots) make it easy for Seattle-area musicians to attend.
